faqs.a:
An employee meeting the retirement eligibility requirements of their retirement plan
               may choose to retire from employment at the city. It is the employee's responsibility
               to notify their supervisor and the human resources department when they are contemplating
               retirement. A 30-day written notice is requested. Upon being qualified under the employee's
               respective retirement plan, the employee may be eligible for retirement health benefits
               as described in the following sections.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
